<!-- sentry-context -->
<script>
  function setSentryUser() {
    try {
      if (typeof Sentry !== 'undefined' && 
          typeof Sentry.isEnabled === 'function' && 
          Sentry.isEnabled() && 
          Sentry.setUser && 
          typeof Sentry.setUser === 'function') {
        Sentry.setUser({
          id: typeof visitor_id !== 'undefined' ? visitor_id : null,
        });
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error setting Sentry user:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.addEventListener('sentryInitialized', function() {
      setSentryUser();
    });
    
    // Fallback: If event already fired (race condition) or Sentry is already initialized
    if (typeof Sentry !== 'undefined' && typeof Sentry.isEnabled === 'function' && Sentry.isEnabled()) {
      setSentryUser();
    }
  }
</script>
